name: SK Chemicals Co., Ltd.
summary: SK Chemicals Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacturing of chemicals, pharmaceuticals and other biomaterials. It operates through the Green Chemicals and Life Science business divisions. The Green Chemicals business division provides Copolyster, coating and adhesive materials, engineering plastic, Prepreg, Bio and 3D printing materials. The Life Science business division offers pharmaceuticals, vaccines and plasma derivatives. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
